description: Amazon has raised twenty-five billion dollars through a bond sale.  This funding supports significant expansion of the company's AI data centers.  CEO Andy Jassy views artificial intelligence as a major opportunity.  Amazon plans substantial capital expenditure for AI infrastructure in upcoming years.  This investment reflects a strategy to avoid missing a key technological shift.
title: Amazon sells $25 bn in bonds for what CEO calls 'once in a lifetime opportunity'

author: ARANI BASU
description: TOI understands that Bumrah will begin gradually increasing his bowling workload after suffering an impact injury during the ODI series in England, while Gill has sought help from specialists outside the BCCI for his chronic neck problem.
title: Jasprit Bumrah, Shubman Gill easing back to full fitness

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: Two days after earthquake in Japan, thousands remain without power, water; 28 dead

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Former India captain Ajinkya Rahane has announced his retirement from international cricket. He shared this news through a video message posted on his Instagram account. Rahane represented India in all three formats during his extensive international career. He played 85 Test matches, 90 ODIs, and 20 T20Is for the country. Rahane was also part of India's historic Test series win in Australia in 2020-21.
title: 'Cap 278 signing off': Ajinkya Rahane retires from international cricket

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: Samsung Electronics achieved its highest-ever quarterly operating profit, fueled by strong AI chip demand.  Rival SK Hynix also reported record revenue, reflecting industry strength.  However, investor sentiment declined due to expansion plans and Chinese competition.  Both companies are investing heavily in new chipmaking facilities and data centers.  Global partnerships are strengthening to secure memory chip supplies for AI.
title: Samsung Q2 results: Tech giant posts record high $62 billion profit on AI chip boom

author: SABI HUSSAIN
description: According to the World Anti-Doping Agency’s (WADA) 2024 Testing Figures Report, released in Dec 2025, India registered 260 adverse analytical findings (AAFs) from 7,113 samples collected during the year — a positivity rate of 3.6%. Among countries conducting more than 5,000 tests annually, India recorded the highest positivity rate in the world for the third consecutive year.
title: How India became the world's worst doping ofHow India became the world's worst doping offenderfender: A crisis threatening sports

author: TOI CITY DESK
description: The Cockroach Janta Party demanded answers from Union Home Minister Amit Shah.  Rahul Gandhi alleged Shah ordered police action against student protesters on July twenty.  Gandhi claimed Shah is either culpable or incompetent regarding the incident.  The BJP rejected these allegations, calling them false claims.  The exchange occurs amid ongoing political debate over the protest.
title: 'Answer now': CJP invokes Rahul's claims, questions Shah over July 20 action

author: TOI NEWS DESK
title: 'Even Mughals called Shivaji a chuha': Uddhav likens Gen Z to Maratha warrior

author: LAIRENLAKPAM WARLI
description: Prashant Kishor alleged Bihar Police detained his supporters before the Bankipur bypoll. He claimed the ruling BJP fears losing the assembly seat and orchestrated these detentions. Kishor stated police could not reveal the whereabouts of over sixteen detained supporters. He further alleged the BJP used administrative machinery and a fake video to influence voters. The Jan Suraaj Party founder vowed action against erring police officials after the bypoll.
title: 'BJP fears losing': Prashant Kishor alleges supporters 'picked up' before bypoll

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A US man already serving a lengthy sentence was convicted on new federal charges.  He was found guilty of providing material support to the militant group Hezbollah.  Prosecutors linked his actions to a 1989 fatwa and a later speech.  The author Salman Rushdie testified during the federal trial about the attack.  This conviction adds to his existing sentence for attempted murder.
title: Salman Rushdie stabbing: Attacker convicted on Hezbollah support, terror charges

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: In a shocking turn of events, Kirti Kulhari, the talented actress, encountered cyber fraud in Mumbai. Unidentified criminals infiltrated her mobile phone and credit card, executing unauthorized transactions that totaled Rs 243,852 in mere minutes. Disturbed by this breach, Kulhari promptly reported the incident to the police, prompting the Cyber Cell to launch an investigation. The incident happened while she enjoyed a show at a theatre in Andheri West.
title: Kirti Kulhari loses Rs 2.4 lakh to cyber fraud, files complaint with Mumbai police

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: The three medals added on Wednesday took India's overall tally to 15 medals, including three gold, nine silver and three bronze, helping the country remain eighth on the medal table.
title: CWG 2026 medal tally: Where does India stand after Gavit gold on Day 7?

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Kevin O'Leary suggests China's growing power will unite North American economies.  Canada offers minerals and energy, while the US provides scale and innovation.  Mexico also plays a vital role in the regional economic landscape.  Companies are increasingly using cheaper Chinese artificial intelligence models.  This shift occurs as the race for technological dominance accelerates globally.
title: Kevin O'Leary says China's rise will unite US, Canada and Mexico

author: TNN
description: A trainee IPS officer now faces rape and attempt-to-murder charges.  These new charges were added after the initial complaint of sexual assault.  The officer was previously arrested and sent to judicial remand for fourteen days.  The woman IPS trainee had lodged her complaint eleven days prior to the arrest.  The case involves allegations of sexual misconduct and privacy violations at SVPNPA.
title: 'Demanded multiple relationships': IPS trainee charged with rape of colleague

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Former India hockey captain Viren Rasquinha criticised Hockey India’s decision to replace the team’s iconic blue jersey with saffron ahead of the 2026 Hockey World Cup, calling it "embarrassing" and questioning the change. Hockey India said the new colour symbolises "courage, sacrifice & victory" and represents new beginnings. India’s men and women will begin their World Cup campaigns in Group D.
title: 'Embarrassing': Former hockey captain slams India's blue jersey being replaced by saffron

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A newly surfaced letter written by Princess Diana to a school friend shortly after her 1981 royal wedding paints a picture of a happy honeymoon with then-Prince Charles. However, years later, the late Princess of Wales revealed that the reality behind the scenes was far more painful, describing herself as consumed by Charles' relationship with Camilla Parker Bowles.
title: Diana called Charles honeymoon 'blissful', later said she 'dreamt of Camilla'

author: TNN
description: A Boeing probe found no abnormality in the B787 fuel control switch locking mechanism. This examination was ordered by the DGCA after a crew reported an issue post-landing. The switches control fuel supply and have faced scrutiny after a past crash incident. Further inspection of the complete thrust control module at the OEM facility is currently underway.
title: DGCA-ordered probe cleared Dreamliner fuel switch: Government

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Sreeshankar continued his impressive run at the Commonwealth Games by winning silver in the men's long jump with a best effort of 8.09m. He had also finished second at the 2022 Games, becoming the first Indian to win back-to-back Commonwealth Games medals in the event.
title: CWG: Sreeshankar wins long jump silver; Gavit claims Games record gold

author: DHANANJAY MAHAPATRA
description: The Supreme Court has cleared former Prime Minister Manmohan Singh in a coal block scam case. This decision comes more than eleven years after a Delhi court summoned him as an accused. The court closed the case nearly two years after his demise in November 2024. The apex court quashed the trial court's order taking cognisance of the crime.
title: 2 years after death, SC clears ex-PM Manmohan Singh in Coalgate case

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Brookfield and NextEra Energy plan a significant data centre and energy complex. This massive project will be built on a former uranium enrichment site in Kentucky. The development includes substantial natural gas generation and battery storage capacity.  The privately financed campus is expected to begin operations in phases from 2028.  This initiative aligns with a White House pledge to manage AI infrastructure costs.
title: Brookfield joins US utility for $100 billion data centre at former nuclear site

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: Oil prices declined on Thursday after a significant rally the previous day. Crude oil continued to move out of the Middle East despite escalating conflict. Shipping activity indicated that oil supplies were still finding routes out of the region. Military actions intensified with US-Saudi strikes targeting Iran-backed forces in Iraq. Saudi Arabia is reportedly assembling a coalition to protect Red Sea shipping from Houthi attacks.
title: Crude prices retreat as oil continues flowing through Hormuz alternatives

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Sakshi Chaudhary (51kg), Arundhati Choudhary (70kg), Sachin Siwach (60kg), Ankush Panghal (80kg), Narender Berwal (+90kg) and world champion Jaismine Lamboria (57kg) joined Lovlina Borgohain (75kg), Priya Ghanghas (60kg), Preeti Pawar (54kg) and Jadumani Singh (55kg) in the semifinals of their respective weight categories. India had finished with seven boxing medals in Birmingham - three gold, one silver and three bronze.
title: Record alert: Indian boxers eclipse Birmingham tally with 10 guaranteed medals

author: TNN
description: Road transport minister Nitin Gadkari informed Rajya Sabha about E20 fuel impacts. Studies found no major performance impact on overall vehicle operations. BS-VI vehicles continue meeting emission norms when tested with E20 fuel. Legacy vehicles did not exhibit significant performance variations or abnormal wear. However, some BS-III vehicles may require rubber part replacements.
title: E20 petrol may harm BS-III vehicle rubber parts, says Nitin Gadkari

author: etimes.in
description: Jana Nayagan experienced a box office slowdown on its seventh day. The action drama earned over six crore rupees on Wednesday. Its India net collection has now surpassed one hundred forty-nine crore rupees. Overseas collections have pushed the worldwide gross to over two hundred fifty-five crore rupees. The Tamil version continues to be the film's biggest contributor.
title: 'Jana Nayagan' BO day 7: Vijay's film sees a midweek dip, earns Rs 6.10cr

author: TNN
description: India's economy shows resilience despite global challenges and uncertainties.  Swift policy responses and implementation are crucial for attracting investment.  Rising crude oil prices pose a potential pressure on fiscal and current accounts.  The external sector remains resilient due to strong exports and remittances.  Adverse weather conditions present a risk to farm output and rural demand.
title: Need to reinvent ways to deal with global challenges: Finance ministry

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
title: 1967 warning on tropical mountains trapping species confirmed by beetle study

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Young great white sharks moved from their nursery habitat during Tropical Storm Hilary. Researchers tracked twenty-two sharks using acoustic tags to observe their movements. Many sharks left the area and returned within weeks after conditions improved. The storm caused a significant drop in sea-surface temperature, affecting the sharks. This study offers new insights into marine species' responses to extreme weather events.
title: 22 juvenile great white sharks fled San Diego nursery during Storm Hilary, later returned

author: SHALABH
description: Jagdish Aphale, an IIT Bombay alumnus, has been appointed the Ayodhya Ram temple trust's first secretary. He will also serve as a joint signatory for financial transactions, enhancing accountability. This appointment follows recent resignations and alleged donation theft issues. Aphale previously supervised construction at the temple complex for nearly four years. His integration into the trust's internal processes has been ongoing for two weeks.
title: IIT-B alumnus Aphale named Ram temple trust’s first secretary, will oversee transactions

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Stephen Fleming is reportedly the frontrunner for England's Test head coach position. He has emerged as the preferred candidate after a thorough interview process. Fleming will replace Brendon McCullum, who is now leading England's white-ball teams. Fleming recently concluded a successful eighteen-year tenure with Chennai Super Kings. Joe Root will temporarily lead the team before Fleming's official start.
title: Former CSK coach tipped for England's Test head coach role

author: IP SINGH
description: Amritpal Singh, sought by the FBI, died in a road accident last year.  He had returned to his native village in Jalandhar from the US.  The FBI placed him on its wanted list for alleged involvement in a crime group.  This organization is accused of smuggling large quantities of cocaine and methamphetamine.  Federal authorities seized significant amounts of drugs and firearms during a major operation.
title: Suspect on FBI list died in Jalandhar road crash last year

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: On a picturesque Costa Rican beach, an unexpected sight caught the eyes of researchers when a mother sea turtle arrived with a lively suckerfish clinging to her shell for an astonishing nineteen minutes. The fish, which seemed to adapt momentarily to land, showcased its gill movements. After careful observation, it was returned to its aquatic home, darting away with unexpected vigor, leaving onlookers astonished by its resilience.
title: Remora hitches 19-minute ride as sea turtle lays eggs in Costa Rica

author: ASHISH CHAUHAN
description: US immigration judges issued 801 removal orders for Indian nationals in June 2026. Nationwide deportation rulings accelerated significantly, with a nearly 30% increase in one month. This indicates a faster disposal of immigration cases by US courts. Indian migrants, many from Gujarat and Punjab, face sustained enforcement actions. The data shows immigration courts are disposing of cases at a much faster pace.
title: US judges issue removal orders against 801 Indians in June
